overview.en: This chapter reviews cardiac anatomy and conduction, diagnostic tests and procedures, cardiac surgery, dysrhythmias with defibrillation/cardioversion/pacemakers, coronary artery disease, angina, MI, heart failure, inflammatory heart disease, valvular disease, cardiomyopathy, vascular and arterial disorders, aneurysms, and hypertension. Priorities: recognize life-threatening rhythms, perfusion problems, and post-procedure complications.
overview.zh: 本章涵蓋心臟解剖與傳導系統、診斷檢查與處置、心臟手術、心律不整(含去顫/電擊/節律器)、冠狀動脈疾病、心絞痛、心肌梗塞、心衰竭、心臟發炎性疾病、瓣膜疾病、心肌病變、血管與動脈疾病、動脈瘤及高血壓。重點為辨識致命性心律、灌流問題及術後併發症。

points.en: Heart wall: epicardium (outer), myocardium (muscle), endocardium (inner lining). Pericardial space holds 5-20 mL fluid.
points.zh: 心壁分三層:心外膜、心肌層、心內膜。心包腔內含5-20 mL液體。

points.en: Valves: tricuspid and mitral (AV valves) close at start of ventricular contraction; pulmonic and aortic (semilunar) open during contraction.
points.zh: 瓣膜:三尖瓣與二尖瓣(房室瓣)於心室收縮開始時關閉;肺動脈瓣與主動脈瓣(半月瓣)於收縮時開啟。

points.en: Conduction: SA node 60-100/min, AV node 40-60/min as backup, Purkinje fibers 20-40/min.
points.zh: 傳導:竇房結60-100次/分;房室結備援40-60次/分;浦金氏纖維20-40次/分。

points.en: Coronary arteries: RCA supplies SA/AV nodes and inferior wall; LAD supplies anterior wall, septum and apex; circumflex supplies lateral and posterior wall.
points.zh: 冠狀動脈:右冠狀動脈供應竇房結/房室結與下壁;左前降支供應前壁、中隔與心尖;迴旋支供應側壁與後壁。

points.en: S1 = AV valves closing (loudest at apex); S2 = semilunar valves closing; S3 suggests heart failure/regurgitation (normal under 30); S4 suggests stiff ventricle.
points.zh: S1為房室瓣關閉(心尖最清楚);S2為半月瓣關閉;S3提示心衰竭/逆流(30歲以下可正常);S4提示心室僵硬。

points.en: Sympathetic (norepinephrine) raises HR, contractility and vasoconstriction; parasympathetic (acetylcholine) lowers HR. Baroreceptors in aortic arch and carotid sinuses regulate BP.
points.zh: 交感神經(norepinephrine)使心率、收縮力與血管收縮增加;副交感(acetylcholine)使心率下降。壓力感受器位於主動脈弓與頸動脈竇,調節血壓。

points.en: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone: renin makes angiotensin I, converted to II in lungs; AII causes vasoconstriction and aldosterone-driven Na/water retention.
points.zh: 腎素-血管收縮素-醛固酮系統:腎素產生血管收縮素I,於肺轉成II;AII引起血管收縮與醛固酮造成鈉水滯留。

points.en: Troponin I rises within 3 hours and stays elevated 7-10 days (normal <0.35 ng/mL; troponin T <0.1). High-sensitivity troponin detects injury in 60-90 minutes.
points.zh: Troponin I於3小時內上升,持續7-10天(正常<0.35 ng/mL;troponin T<0.1)。高敏感度troponin可在60-90分鐘偵測損傷。

points.en: CK-MB (2-6 ng/mL) rises within hours, peaks at 18 hours; myoglobin rises in 2 hours, declines by 7 hours but is not cardiac specific.
points.zh: CK-MB(2-6 ng/mL)數小時內上升,18小時達高峰;肌紅素2小時上升、7小時後下降,但非心臟特異。

points.en: BNP normally <100 ng/mL; higher means more severe heart failure. hsCRP <1 mg/L low risk, >3 mg/L high risk.
points.zh: BNP正常<100 ng/mL;越高代表心衰竭越嚴重。hsCRP<1 mg/L低風險,>3 mg/L高風險。

points.en: Hypokalemia: flat/inverted T, U wave, ST depression, ventricular dysrhythmias, digoxin toxicity risk. Hyperkalemia: tall peaked T, wide QRS, flat P, asystole.
points.zh: 低血鉀:T波平坦/倒置、U波、ST下降、心室心律不整、增加digoxin中毒風險。高血鉀:高尖T波、QRS變寬、P波消失、心搏停止。

points.en: Hypocalcemia prolongs ST/QT; hypercalcemia shortens ST, AV block; low magnesium causes VT/VF; high Mg gives weakness, hypotension, bradycardia.
points.zh: 低血鈣使ST/QT延長;高血鈣使ST縮短、房室傳導阻滯;低血鎂可致VT/VF;高血鎂致無力、低血壓、心搏過緩。

points.en: WBC rises after MI; BUN rises in HF/cardiogenic shock; coagulation factors rise after MI; elevated Lp(a) and homocysteine raise CVD risk.
points.zh: MI後白血球上升;心衰竭/心因性休克時BUN上升;MI後凝血因子上升;Lp(a)與同半胱胺酸升高增加心血管風險。

heading.en: Diagnostic procedures, cardiac catheterization and revascularization
heading.zh: 診斷處置、心導管與血運重建

points.en: ECG basics: PR 0.12-0.20 s, QRS 0.04-0.10 s, QT 0.32-0.40 s; each small box 0.04 s, large 0.20 s. Holter records 24+ hours.
points.zh: 心電圖基礎:PR 0.12-0.20秒、QRS 0.04-0.10秒、QT 0.32-0.40秒;小格0.04秒、大格0.20秒。Holter監測24小時以上。

points.en: Stress test: avoid smoking, alcohol, caffeine; beta/calcium blockers usually held that day, theophylline 12 hours before; dipyridamole/dobutamine if cannot exercise.
points.zh: 運動負荷測試:避免吸菸、酒精、咖啡因;當天通常停用β阻斷劑/鈣通道阻斷劑,theophylline於前12小時停用;無法運動者用dipyridamole/dobutamine。

points.en: MRI: screen for pacemaker/metal. TEE is invasive (prepare like endoscopy).
points.zh: MRI:檢查有無節律器/金屬。經食道超音波(TEE)為侵入性,準備類似內視鏡。

points.en: Cardiac cath pre-procedure: consent, check iodine/seafood allergy, NPO (solids 6-8 h, liquids 4 h), baseline pulses and weight; hold metformin 24 hours before and until renal function reviewed (about 48 hours after).
points.zh: 心導管術前:同意書、確認碘/海鮮過敏、禁食(固體6-8小時、液體4小時)、記錄基線脈搏與體重;metformin術前24小時停用,待腎功能確認後(約術後48小時)恢復。

points.en: Post-cath: vitals and rhythm q30 min x 2 hours; check distal pulses, color, warmth; cool/pale limb or lost pulse = emergency (clot). Bleeding: manual pressure. Extremity straight 4-6 h, bed rest 6-12 h, HOB no more than 15 degrees if no closure device; push fluids to flush dye.
points.zh: 心導管術後:前2小時每30分鐘監測生命徵象與心律;檢查遠端脈搏、顏色、溫度;肢體冰冷蒼白或脈搏消失為急症(血栓)。出血時手動加壓。無縫合裝置時肢體伸直4-6小時、臥床6-12小時,床頭≤15度;鼓勵補充水分以排除顯影劑。

points.en: PTCA balloon dilates artery; complications: dissection, rupture, embolization, spasm, MI, reocclusion. Stents need antiplatelets (clopidogrel + aspirin) for months; IV nitroglycerin may prevent spasm.
points.zh: PTCA以球囊擴張血管;併發症:剝離、破裂、栓塞、痙攣、心肌梗塞、再阻塞。支架術後需抗血小板藥(clopidogrel+aspirin)數月;IV nitroglycerin可預防痙攣。

points.en: Other options: laser angioplasty, atherectomy, transmyocardial revascularization, IVUS, CAC score >300 high risk.
points.zh: 其他:雷射血管成形術、粥狀斑塊切除術、經心肌雷射血管重建術、血管內超音波;冠狀動脈鈣化分數>300為高風險。

heading.zh: 冠狀動脈繞道手術與心臟移植

points.en: CABG uses saphenous vein or internal mammary artery; MIDCAB for LAD lesions needs no sternotomy or bypass pump.
points.zh: 冠狀動脈繞道術使用隱靜脈或內乳動脈;MIDCAB用於左前降支病灶,不需胸骨切開或體外循環。

points.en: Pre-op: teach splinting, coughing, incentive spirometer, tubes/ventilator; diuretics stopped 2-3 days, digoxin 12 hours, aspirin/anticoagulants 1 week before.
points.zh: 術前:教導按壓傷口、咳嗽、誘發性肺量計、管路/呼吸器;利尿劑術前2-3天、digoxin術前12小時、aspirin/抗凝血劑術前1週停用。

points.en: Post-op: chest tube drainage over 100-150 mL/hr reported; keep K+ 4-5 mEq/L; fluids 1500-2000 mL; rewarm no faster than 1.8 degrees per hour; ground equipment for epicardial wires (microshock).
points.zh: 術後:胸管引流量>100-150 mL/小時需通報;維持鉀4-5 mEq/L;液體限制1500-2000 mL;回溫速度每小時不超過1.8度;心外膜導線設備須接地(防微電擊)。

points.en: Tamponade signs: sudden stop of heavy mediastinal drainage, JVD with clear lungs, equalized pressures, pulsus paradoxus. Anginal pain suggests graft failure.
points.zh: 心包填塞徵象:大量縱隔引流突然停止、頸靜脈怒張但肺部清晰、壓力趨於相等、奇脈。心絞痛樣疼痛提示移植血管失敗。

points.en: Recovery: stop activity if BP drops 10-20 mm Hg or pulse rises over 10; sternum heals 6-8 weeks; avoid pushing/pulling 6 weeks; infection if WBC/fever persists after 3-4 days.
points.zh: 恢復:血壓下降10-20 mm Hg或脈搏增加>10次應停止活動;胸骨約6-8週癒合;6週內避免推拉;3-4天後仍發燒/白血球高提示感染。

points.en: Heart transplant: lifelong immunosuppression, infection risk, denervated heart (no angina, resting rate about 100, slow response to exercise), two P waves on ECG, rejection signs: hypotension, dysrhythmias, fatigue; biopsies for surveillance.
points.zh: 心臟移植:終身免疫抑制、感染風險、心臟去神經(無心絞痛、靜止心率約100、運動反應慢)、心電圖有兩種P波、排斥徵象:低血壓、心律不整、疲倦;定期心內膜切片。

points.en: Estimate rate with 6-second strip x 10. Normal sinus rhythm: regular, 60-100, normal PR and QRS.
points.zh: 以6秒心電圖條帶QRS數x10估算心率。正常竇性心律:規則、60-100次/分、PR與QRS正常。

points.en: Sinus bradycardia (<60): treat if symptomatic with oxygen, atropine (avoid extra doses), then transcutaneous pacing; hold causative drugs.
points.zh: 竇性心搏過緩(<60):有症狀時給氧、atropine(避免多餘劑量),再用經皮節律器;暫停可疑藥物。

points.en: Sinus tachycardia (100-180): find and treat the cause.
points.zh: 竇性心搏過速(100-180):找出並治療原因。

points.en: Atrial fibrillation: 350-600 chaotic atrial impulses, no P waves, fibrillatory waves, thrombus/stroke risk; give anticoagulants, rate control, cardioversion (anticoagulate 4-6 weeks and TEE first, hold digoxin 48 h).
points.zh: 心房顫動:每分鐘350-600次紊亂心房衝動、無P波、有顫動波、有血栓/中風風險;給予抗凝血劑、控制心室率、電擊(術前抗凝4-6週並做TEE,停digoxin 48小時)。

points.en: PVCs: check O2 sat and K+; notify provider for chest pain, increased frequency, multifocal, R-on-T, or runs of VT. Bigeminy, trigeminy, couplets described.
points.zh: PVC:檢查血氧與鉀;若胸痛、頻率增加、多源性、R-on-T或連續VT需通知醫師。依序有二聯、三聯、成對等型態。

points.en: VT (140-250/min): stable = oxygen plus antidysrhythmics; unstable with pulse = synchronized cardioversion; pulseless = defibrillation and CPR.
points.zh: VT(140-250次/分):穩定時給氧與抗心律不整藥;不穩定但有脈搏=同步電擊;無脈搏=去顫與CPR。

points.en: VF: no cardiac output, unconscious, no pulse; fatal in 3-5 minutes; CPR then immediate defibrillation, 2 minutes CPR between shocks.
points.zh: VF:無心輸出量、意識喪失、無脈搏;3-5分鐘內致命;CPR並立即去顫,每次電擊間CPR 2分鐘。

points.en: Sudden loss of complexes: assess the client first (asystole vs lead displacement) before touching equipment.
points.zh: 心電圖波形突然消失:先評估個案(心搏停止或電極脫落),再處理儀器。

heading.en: Dysrhythmia management: cardioversion, defibrillation, AICD, pacemakers
heading.zh: 心律不整處置:電擊、去顫、AICD與節律器

points.en: Vagal maneuvers (carotid massage, Valsalva) for supraventricular tachycardia; need monitor, defibrillator ready, record strips.
points.zh: 迷走神經刺激(頸動脈按摩、Valsalva)用於上心室心搏過速;需心電監測、備妥去顫器並記錄心電圖。

points.en: Cardioversion is synchronized (to R wave) with lower energy; sedate, consent if elective; turn off oxygen; clear everyone; after: airway first, then vitals, rhythm, chest burns.
points.zh: 電擊(同步於R波)使用較低能量;給予鎮靜、擇期需同意書;關閉氧氣;確認無人接觸;術後先確保呼吸道,再評估生命徵象、心律與胸部灼傷。

points.en: Defibrillation is asynchronous for pulseless VT/VF: 120-200 J biphasic or 360 J monophasic; resume CPR immediately; confirm rhythm after placing pads; do not delay for drugs.
points.zh: 去顫為非同步,用於無脈搏VT/VF:雙相120-200 J或單相360 J;立即恢復CPR;貼電擊板後先確認心律;不因給藥而延遲。

points.en: Pad placement: right of sternum 3rd ICS and left midaxillary 5th ICS; avoid breast tissue, medication patches, implanted devices; AED: stop CPR during analysis, shocks only for pulseless VT/VF.
points.zh: 電擊板位置:胸骨右側第3肋間與左腋中線第5肋間;避開乳房組織、藥物貼片與植入裝置;AED:分析時停止CPR,僅對無脈搏VT/VF放電。

points.en: AICD delivers 25-30 J up to 4 times; client sits or lies down after a shock, keeps a log, avoids strong magnetic fields, contact sports, MRI/diathermy; carry ID card.
points.zh: AICD放電25-30 J、最多4次;被電擊後應坐下或躺下、記錄日誌、避免強磁場、接觸性運動、MRI/透熱療法;隨身攜帶識別卡。

points.en: Pacemakers: demand (senses, paces if rate too low) vs fixed rate; spike before P = atrial pacing, before QRS = ventricular; capture = spike followed by depolarization.
points.zh: 節律器:需求型(感知後才起搏)與固定頻率型;P波前尖峰=心房起搏、QRS前尖峰=心室起搏;有後續去極化即為起搏成功(capture)。

points.en: Transcutaneous pacing: do not take pulse/BP on left side; lack of capture = check skin contact then raise current. Temporary wires: insulate, ground equipment to prevent microshock.
points.zh: 經皮起搏:勿測左側脈搏/血壓;失去capture時先檢查皮膚接觸,再提高電流。暫時性導線:絕緣、設備接地以防微電擊。

points.en: Permanent pacemaker: limit operative arm movement, report fever/swelling, dizziness, edema; battery 10 years (lithium); use cell phone on opposite side; avoid strong electromagnetic fields.
points.zh: 永久性節律器:限制術側手臂活動、通報發燒/腫脹、頭暈、水腫;鋰電池約10年;手機用對側耳朵;避免強電磁場。

heading.zh: 冠狀動脈疾病與心絞痛

points.en: CAD = atherosclerosis narrowing coronaries; significant when left main lumen reduced 50% or a major branch 75%.
points.zh: CAD為粥狀硬化使冠狀動脈狹窄;左主幹管徑減少50%或主要分支減少75%即有意義。

points.en: Ischemia: ST depression/T inversion; infarction: ST elevation, then T inversion and Q wave. Manage risk factors, diet low in calories, sodium, cholesterol and fat.
points.zh: 缺血:ST下降/T波倒置;梗塞:ST上升,繼而T波倒置與Q波。控制危險因子,低熱量、低鈉、低膽固醇、低脂飲食。

points.en: Angina is O2 supply-demand imbalance. Stable: exertion, relieved by rest/NTG. Unstable: unpredictable, >15 min, escalating, may not respond to NTG. Variant (Prinzmetal): coronary spasm at rest, ST elevation.
points.zh: 心絞痛為氧供需失衡。穩定型:運動誘發、休息/NTG可緩解。不穩定型:不可預測、>15分鐘、逐漸加重、NTG可能無效。變異型(Prinzmetal):冠狀動脈痙攣、休息時發作、ST上升。

points.en: Angina pain: substernal, squeezing, radiates to arm/jaw/back, usually <5 min (up to 15-20), relieved by rest or NTG; troponin normal.
points.zh: 心絞痛疼痛:胸骨下壓榨感、放射至手臂/下顎/背部,通常<5分鐘(最長15-20分鐘),休息或NTG緩解;troponin正常。

points.en: Acute angina: stop activity, oxygen, monitor, NTG, semi-Fowler, 12-lead ECG, IV access; at home call EMS if NTG fails (aspirin may be chewed).
points.zh: 急性心絞痛:停止活動、給氧、監測、NTG、半坐臥、12導程心電圖、建立靜脈管路;居家NTG無效應叫救護車(可嚼服aspirin)。

points.en: Medications: nitrates, calcium channel blockers (variant angina; avoid grapefruit juice), beta blockers, statins, antiplatelets.
points.zh: 藥物:硝酸鹽、鈣通道阻斷劑(變異型心絞痛;避免葡萄柚汁)、β阻斷劑、statin、抗血小板藥。

points.en: Evolves over hours; blue swollen area by 6 hours, gray with yellow streaks at 48 hours, granulation 8-10 days, scar 2-3 months. LAD = anterior/septal; circumflex = lateral/posterior; RCA = inferior.
points.zh: 梗塞數小時內進展;6小時呈藍色腫脹、48小時灰色帶黃紋、8-10天形成肉芽組織、2-3個月形成疤痕。LAD=前壁/中隔;迴旋支=側壁/後壁;RCA=下壁。

points.en: Pain: crushing substernal, radiates to jaw/back/left arm, lasts 30+ minutes, not relieved by rest or NTG (opioids needed); nausea, diaphoresis, dyspnea, doom; women/older adults may present atypically (fatigue, dyspnea, confusion).
points.zh: 疼痛:胸骨下壓榨痛、放射至下顎/背/左臂、持續30分鐘以上、休息或NTG無法緩解(需鴉片類);噁心、冒汗、呼吸困難、瀕死感;女性/老年人可能症狀不典型(疲倦、呼吸困難、意識混亂)。

points.en: Labs: troponin 3 h-7-10 days; CK-MB peaks 18 h, normal in 48-72 h; myoglobin 2 h; WBC up day 2. ECG: STEMI, T inversion, Q waves persist.
points.zh: 檢驗:troponin 3小時起、持續7-10天;CK-MB 18小時達高峰、48-72小時恢復;肌紅素2小時;白血球第2天上升。心電圖:STEMI、T波倒置、Q波持續存在。

points.en: Acute care: morphine is priority for pain (reduces O2 demand), oxygen, NTG, monitor, semi-Fowler, IV, 12-lead ECG, beta blockers, thrombolytics within 6 hours if no emergent cath/PTCA.
points.zh: 急性期:疼痛處置首選morphine(降低耗氧)、給氧、NTG、監測、半坐臥、靜脈管路、12導程心電圖、β阻斷劑,若無緊急心導管/PTCA則6小時內給血栓溶解劑。

points.en: If SBP <100 or 25 mm Hg below prior, lower HOB and notify provider. Watch for poor output (cool, clammy, weak pulses), HF, dysrhythmias (PVCs, tachycardia in first hours).
points.zh: 若收縮壓<100或比先前低25 mm Hg,降低床頭並通知醫師。注意輸出不足(冰冷濕黏、脈搏弱)、心衰竭、心律不整(最初數小時PVC、心搏過速)。

points.en: Complications: dysrhythmias, HF, pulmonary edema, cardiogenic shock, pericarditis, mitral insufficiency, ventricular rupture, Dressler syndrome.
points.zh: 併發症:心律不整、心衰竭、肺水腫、心因性休克、心包炎、二尖瓣閉鎖不全、心室破裂、Dressler症候群。

points.en: Recovery: progressive activity (dangle, chair 30 min x3, ambulation), ACE inhibitor/ARB, aspirin, clopidogrel, lipid-lowering drugs; cardiac rehabilitation.
points.zh: 恢復期:漸進活動(床邊垂腿、下床坐椅30分鐘x3、步行)、ACE抑制劑/ARB、aspirin、clopidogrel、降血脂藥;心臟復健。

points.en: HF = inability to maintain output for metabolic needs. Systolic (HFrEF) = poor ejection; diastolic (HFpEF) = poor filling. Left failure often first; compensation (tachycardia, vasoconstriction, Na/water retention, hypertrophy) eventually harms.
points.zh: 心衰竭為心輸出量無法滿足代謝需求。收縮性(HFrEF)=射血差;舒張性(HFpEF)=充填差。多始於左心衰竭;代償機制(心搏過速、血管收縮、鈉水滯留、肥厚)終致傷害。

points.en: Left HF: pulmonary congestion - dyspnea, crackles, cough, PND, nocturia. Right HF: systemic - dependent edema, JVD, hepatomegaly, abdominal distention, weight gain.
points.zh: 左心衰竭:肺部鬱血-呼吸困難、囉音、咳嗽、夜間陣發性呼吸困難、夜尿。右心衰竭:全身性-下垂性水腫、頸靜脈怒張、肝腫大、腹脹、體重增加。

points.en: Acute pulmonary edema: severe dyspnea, crackles/wheezing, pink frothy sputum, anxiety, cold clammy skin, cyanosis, SpO2 low.
points.zh: 急性肺水腫:嚴重呼吸困難、囉音/喘鳴、粉紅泡沫痰、焦慮、皮膚冰冷濕黏、發紺、血氧低。

points.en: Emergency: high-Fowler, stay with client, get help, oxygen, IV access, furosemide, morphine IV, Foley, prepare for intubation.
points.zh: 急救:高坐臥、陪伴個案、呼叫協助、給氧、靜脈管路、furosemide、IV morphine、導尿、準備插管。

points.en: Home teaching: daily weights, report edema/weight gain, low sodium/fat/cholesterol diet, potassium foods (except with K-sparing diuretics), spread fluids and hard candy for thirst, avoid isometrics, caffeine and OTC drugs, balance rest and activity.
points.zh: 居家衛教:每日量體重、通報水腫/體重增加、低鈉低脂低膽固醇飲食、攝取高鉀食物(使用保鉀利尿劑除外)、液體分散攝取並含硬糖止渴、避免等長運動、咖啡因與成藥、活動與休息平衡。

points.en: Typical medications: digoxin, diuretics, ACE inhibitors, low-dose beta blockers, vasodilators.
points.zh: 常用藥物:digoxin、利尿劑、ACE抑制劑、低劑量β阻斷劑、血管擴張劑。

heading.en: Inflammatory heart disease and cardiac tamponade
heading.zh: 心臟發炎性疾病與心包填塞

points.en: Pericarditis: sharp pleuritic chest pain worse supine/inspiration, relieved leaning forward, friction rub, fever, ST elevation, AF; give NSAIDs/steroids, oxygen, sit upright leaning forward; watch for tamponade.
points.zh: 心包炎:尖銳的胸膜性胸痛、平躺/吸氣時加重、前傾可緩解、心包摩擦音、發燒、ST上升、心房顫動;給NSAIDs/類固醇、氧氣、前傾坐姿;注意心包填塞。

points.en: Myocarditis: fever, dyspnea, tachycardia, friction rub, gallop, murmur, HF signs; treat with analgesics, antibiotics, digoxin, antidysrhythmics.
points.zh: 心肌炎:發燒、呼吸困難、心搏過速、摩擦音、奔馬律、雜音、心衰竭徵象;予止痛劑、抗生素、digoxin、抗心律不整藥。

points.en: Endocarditis: risk with IV drug use, prosthetic valves, dental/invasive procedures; signs: fever, murmur, petechiae, splinter hemorrhages, Osler nodes (tender), Janeway lesions (nontender), clubbing, embolic events.
points.zh: 心內膜炎:風險包括靜脈藥物濫用、人工瓣膜、牙科/侵入性處置;徵象:發燒、雜音、瘀點、甲下線狀出血、Osler結節(有壓痛)、Janeway病灶(無壓痛)、杵狀指、栓塞事件。

points.en: Endocarditis care: IV antibiotics, blood cultures, watch for splenic (left shoulder pain), renal (flank pain, hematuria), CNS (confusion, aphasia), pulmonary emboli; teach oral hygiene with soft brush, prophylactic antibiotics before dental work, temperature daily for 6 weeks.
points.zh: 心內膜炎處置:IV抗生素、血液培養、監測脾栓塞(左肩痛)、腎栓塞(側腹痛、血尿)、中樞栓塞(意識混亂、失語)、肺栓塞;教導軟毛牙刷口腔衛生、牙科前預防性抗生素、6週內每日量體溫。

points.en: Tamponade: fluid in pericardium restricts filling (20-50 mL rapid can be acute). Signs: pulsus paradoxus, JVD with clear lungs, muffled heart sounds, narrowing pulse pressure, hypotension, rising CVP.
points.zh: 心包填塞:心包液體限制心室充填(快速累積20-50 mL即可急性發作)。徵象:奇脈、頸靜脈怒張但肺清晰、心音遙遠、脈壓變窄、低血壓、中心靜脈壓上升。

points.en: Tamponade care: ICU hemodynamic monitoring, IV fluids, pericardiocentesis; success = clear lungs, normal JVD, lower CVP, higher BP.
points.zh: 填塞處置:加護病房血行動力監測、靜脈輸液、心包穿刺;成功指標:肺清晰、頸靜脈正常、CVP下降、血壓上升。

heading.en: Valvular disease, cardiomyopathy and venous disorders
heading.zh: 瓣膜疾病、心肌病變與靜脈疾病

points.en: Stenosis = valve will not open fully; insufficiency/regurgitation = will not close. Aortic stenosis: exertional dyspnea, angina, syncope, harsh systolic murmur; aortic insufficiency: blowing diastolic murmur.
points.zh: 狹窄=瓣膜無法完全開啟;閉鎖不全/逆流=無法完全關閉。主動脈狹窄:運動時呼吸困難、心絞痛、昏厥、粗糙收縮期雜音;主動脈閉鎖不全:吹風樣舒張期雜音。

points.en: Mechanical valve: durable, lifelong anticoagulation; bioprosthetic (pig/cow/human): less durable, often no long-term anticoagulant. Teach oral hygiene, prophylactic antibiotics, MedicAlert; stop anticoagulants about 72 hours before surgery.
points.zh: 機械瓣膜:耐久,需終身抗凝;生物瓣膜(豬/牛/人):較不耐用,多不需長期抗凝。教導口腔衛生、預防性抗生素、MedicAlert手環;手術前約72小時停抗凝劑。

points.en: Cardiomyopathy: dilated (dilated chambers, HF, emboli), hypertrophic (thick septum, sudden death; avoid digoxin/nitrates if obstructed), restrictive (stiff walls, right HF).
points.zh: 心肌病變:擴張型(腔室擴大、心衰竭、栓塞)、肥厚型(中隔肥厚、猝死;阻塞型避免digoxin/硝酸鹽)、限制型(心壁僵硬、右心衰竭)。

points.en: Thrombophlebitis/DVT: calf pain, warmth, swelling; Homans sign unreliable; bed rest, elevate leg, no massage, no knee gatch/pillow under knees, antiembolism stockings, heparin (aPTT) then warfarin (INR); watch for PE (dyspnea, chest pain).
points.zh: 血栓性靜脈炎/DVT:小腿疼痛、發熱、腫脹;Homans徵象不可靠;臥床、抬高肢體、不按摩、勿用膝下枕/膝部支架、抗栓襪、heparin(aPTT)後接warfarin(INR);注意肺栓塞(呼吸困難、胸痛)。

points.en: Superficial phlebitis: warm moist soaks. Venous insufficiency: edema, brown stasis dermatitis, ulcers at lateral malleolus; leg elevation, compression stockings (put on before rising), Unna boot (saline only, no povidone-iodine/peroxide, check for arterial occlusion).
points.zh: 表淺靜脈炎:溫濕敷。靜脈功能不全:水腫、棕色鬱積性皮膚炎、外踝潰瘍;抬腿、壓力襪(起床前穿上)、Unna boot(僅用生理食鹽水,不用優碘/雙氧水,注意動脈阻塞)。

points.en: Varicose veins: aching legs, Trendelenburg test (veins fill from proximal end); stockings, leg elevation, sclerotherapy, laser, stripping.
points.zh: 靜脈曲張:腿部酸痛、Trendelenburg測試(靜脈由近端充盈);穿彈性襪、抬腿、硬化療法、雷射、靜脈剝除。

heading.zh: 動脈疾病、動脈瘤、取栓術與高血壓

points.en: PAD: intermittent claudication, rest pain relieved by dependency, cool gray-blue skin, hair loss, thick nails, elevational pallor/dependent rubor, absent pulses, ulcers on toes. Keep legs level or slightly dependent (not above heart), walk to claudication then rest, no heat, no smoking/caffeine, no crossing legs.
points.zh: 周邊動脈疾病:間歇性跛行、下垂可緩解的休息痛、皮膚冰冷灰藍、掉毛、趾甲增厚、抬高蒼白/下垂潮紅、脈搏消失、趾部潰瘍。腿部保持水平或略下垂(不高於心臟)、走到跛行再休息、不可直接加熱、戒菸與咖啡因、勿翹腳。

points.en: After arterial bypass: warmth, redness, edema expected (increased flow); sharp pain increase or lost pulse = graft occlusion (call immediately); keep leg straight, avoid hip/knee flexion; watch BP (hypotension and hypertension both harmful).
points.zh: 動脈繞道術後:溫熱、發紅、水腫為預期(血流增加);疼痛突然加劇或脈搏消失=移植血管阻塞(立即通報);肢體伸直、避免髖/膝彎曲;注意血壓(過低或過高皆有害)。

points.en: Raynaud: vasospasm with cold/stress, white-blue-red color change; avoid cold, smoking, injury; vasodilators. Buerger: smokers, claudication, rest pain, ulcers; same care.
points.zh: 雷諾氏症:受冷/壓力引發血管痙攣、白-藍-紅變色;避免寒冷、吸菸、受傷;血管擴張劑。Buerger病:吸菸者、跛行、休息痛、潰瘍;照護同上。

points.en: Aortic aneurysm: fusiform, saccular, dissecting, false. AAA: pulsating abdominal mass, bruit; do NOT palpate deeply. Rupture: severe abdominal/back pain, flank hematoma, hypotension, shock. Thoracic: hoarseness, dysphagia, back pain.
points.zh: 主動脈瘤:梭狀、囊狀、剝離、假性。腹主動脈瘤:搏動性腹部腫塊、血管雜音;不可深壓觸診。破裂:劇烈腹/背痛、側腹血腫、低血壓、休克。胸主動脈瘤:聲音沙啞、吞嚥困難、背痛。

points.en: AAA repair post-op: check pulses distal to graft, HOB max 45 degrees, NG suction, urine output hourly (report <30-50 mL/hr, rising BUN/creatinine = acute kidney injury), no lifting >15-20 lb for 6-12 weeks.
points.zh: 腹主動脈瘤術後:檢查移植血管遠端脈搏、床頭最高45度、鼻胃管抽吸、每小時尿量(<30-50 mL/hr、BUN/肌酐上升=急性腎損傷需通報)、6-12週內不提超過15-20磅重物。

points.en: Embolectomy: baseline pulses, bed cradle, extremity slightly dependent; watch reperfusion compartment swelling (pain on passive movement, tense muscle, numbness).
points.zh: 取栓術:基線脈搏、床架、肢體略下垂;注意再灌流造成肌肉腫脹(被動活動疼痛、肌肉緊繃、麻木)。

points.en: Vena cava filter traps emboli to prevent PE; held anticoagulants pre-op per provider.
points.zh: 下腔靜脈濾器可攔截栓子以預防肺栓塞;術前依醫囑停用抗凝劑。

points.en: BP categories: normal <120/<80; elevated 120-129/<80; stage 1 130-139 or 80-89; stage 2 >=140 or >=90. Higher value classifies.
Lifestyle: sodium about 2 g/day, weight loss, exercise (no isometrics/heavy lifting), limit alcohol/caffeine, stop smoking; drugs lifelong, never stop for side effects without calling.
points.zh: 生活型態:鈉約2 g/天、減重、運動(避免等長/重量訓練)、限制酒精/咖啡因、戒菸;藥物需終身服用,有副作用先聯絡醫療人員,勿自行停藥。

points.en: Hypertensive crisis: SBP >180 and/or DBP >120 with headache, confusion, blurred vision; IV antihypertensives, BP q5 min, HOB 45 degrees, airway, Foley, I&O, watch for hypotension.
points.zh: 高血壓危象:收縮壓>180和/或舒張壓>120伴頭痛、意識混亂、視力模糊;IV降壓藥、每5分鐘量血壓、床頭45度、維持呼吸道、導尿、記錄輸出入、注意低血壓。

critical_points.en: Cardiac cath: withhold metformin 24 h before and until renal function is confirmed (about 48 h after); check allergy to iodine/seafood; post-procedure check distal pulse and bleeding.
critical_points.zh: 心導管:metformin術前24小時停用,待腎功能確認後(約術後48小時)再用;確認碘/海鮮過敏;術後檢查遠端脈搏與出血。

critical_points.en: Cool, pale, pulseless or numb extremity after cath or arterial surgery = possible clot, emergency.
critical_points.zh: 心導管或動脈手術後肢體冰冷、蒼白、無脈或麻木=可能血栓,屬急症。

critical_points.en: Symptomatic sinus bradycardia: oxygen, atropine, then transcutaneous pacing; avoid repeated atropine.
critical_points.zh: 有症狀的竇性心搏過緩:給氧、atropine,再用經皮節律器;避免重複給atropine。

critical_points.en: VF/pulseless VT: CPR, immediate defibrillation (120-200 J biphasic, 360 J monophasic), unsynchronized, confirm rhythm; fatal in 3-5 minutes.
critical_points.zh: VF/無脈搏VT:CPR、立即去顫(雙相120-200 J、單相360 J)、非同步、確認心律;3-5分鐘內致命。

critical_points.en: Cardioversion is synchronized to the R wave to avoid the T wave; before: anticoagulation 4-6 weeks plus TEE for AF, hold digoxin 48 h; after: airway first.
critical_points.zh: 電擊與R波同步以避開T波;術前:心房顫動需抗凝4-6週加TEE、停digoxin 48小時;術後先確保呼吸道。

critical_points.en: Before shocking: turn off oxygen, clear everyone (check 3 times).
critical_points.zh: 放電前:關閉氧氣、確認無人接觸(檢查三次)。

critical_points.en: R-on-T PVC, multifocal PVCs, runs of VT, or PVCs with chest pain: notify provider; first check BP and SpO2.
critical_points.zh: R-on-T PVC、多源性PVC、連續VT或PVC合併胸痛:通知醫師;先檢查血壓與血氧。

critical_points.en: Atrial fibrillation: no P waves, fibrillatory waves, anticoagulate for stroke risk; rapid rate drops cardiac output (syncope, dizziness, palpitations).
critical_points.zh: 心房顫動:無P波、有顫動波、需抗凝預防中風;速率快使心輸出量下降(昏厥、頭暈、心悸)。

critical_points.en: MI: crushing pain over 30 minutes unrelieved by rest or NTG; morphine is priority analgesic; troponin rises in 3 hours; thrombolytics within 6 hours if no emergent cath.
critical_points.zh: MI:壓榨痛超過30分鐘、休息或NTG無效;morphine為優先止痛;troponin 3小時上升;若無緊急心導管則6小時內給血栓溶解劑。

critical_points.en: Troponin and enzymes are normal in stable angina; elevated in MI.
critical_points.zh: 穩定型心絞痛troponin與酵素正常;MI時升高。

critical_points.en: Women and older adults often have atypical MI symptoms (fatigue, dyspnea, confusion, NSTEMI).
critical_points.zh: 女性與老年人MI常症狀不典型(疲倦、呼吸困難、意識混亂、NSTEMI)。

critical_points.en: Acute pulmonary edema: high-Fowler, oxygen, furosemide, morphine, Foley; crackles and pink frothy sputum; do not delay for transport.
critical_points.zh: 急性肺水腫:高坐臥、給氧、furosemide、morphine、導尿;囉音與粉紅泡沫痰;勿因轉送而延遲處置。

critical_points.en: Left HF signs are pulmonary; right HF signs are systemic (edema, JVD, hepatomegaly).
critical_points.zh: 左心衰竭徵象在肺部;右心衰竭徵象在全身(水腫、頸靜脈怒張、肝腫大)。

critical_points.en: Tamponade: JVD with clear lungs, muffled heart sounds, pulsus paradoxus, narrow pulse pressure; pericardiocentesis. Sudden stop of mediastinal drainage after cardiac surgery is a warning.
critical_points.zh: 心包填塞:頸靜脈怒張但肺清晰、心音遙遠、奇脈、脈壓變窄;心包穿刺。心臟手術後縱隔引流突然停止為警訊。

critical_points.en: Endocarditis: Osler nodes (tender), Janeway lesions (nontender), splinter hemorrhages; prophylactic antibiotics before dental work for prosthetic valves.
critical_points.zh: 心內膜炎:Osler結節(痛)、Janeway病灶(不痛)、甲下線狀出血;人工瓣膜者牙科前預防性抗生素。

critical_points.en: DVT: no massage, no knee gatch or pillow under knees; heparin with aPTT, warfarin with INR; watch for PE.
critical_points.zh: DVT:不按摩、勿用膝部支架或膝下枕;heparin監測aPTT、warfarin監測INR;注意肺栓塞。

critical_points.en: PAD: do not elevate legs above heart; no heat; walk until claudication then rest. Venous insufficiency: elevate legs.
critical_points.zh: 周邊動脈疾病:腿不可高於心臟;不可加熱;走到跛行後休息。靜脈功能不全:需抬腿。

critical_points.en: AAA: do not palpate deeply; rupture = severe back/abdominal pain, shock; post-op urine output under 30 mL/hr and rising creatinine = acute kidney injury, call provider.
critical_points.zh: 腹主動脈瘤:不可深壓觸診;破裂=劇烈背/腹痛、休克;術後尿量<30 mL/hr與肌酐上升=急性腎損傷,通知醫師。

critical_points.en: Hypertensive crisis: SBP >180 and/or DBP >120; IV antihypertensives; BP every 5 minutes; HOB 45 degrees.
critical_points.zh: 高血壓危象:收縮壓>180和/或舒張壓>120;IV降壓藥;每5分鐘量血壓;床頭45度。

mnemonics.en: Coronary territories: LAD = anterior (Left Anterior); RCA = inferior, SA and AV nodes; circumflex = lateral/posterior.
mnemonics.zh: 冠狀動脈供血區:LAD=前壁;RCA=下壁、竇房結與房室結;迴旋支=側/後壁。

mnemonics.en: Rate by 6-second strip: count QRS in 6 seconds x 10.
Angina = relieved by rest/NTG, short, normal troponin; MI = unrelieved, 30+ min, troponin up.
mnemonics.zh: 心絞痛=休息/NTG緩解、短暫、troponin正常;MI=無法緩解、30分鐘以上、troponin升高。

mnemonics.en: Left HF = Lungs; Right HF = Rest of the body (edema, JVD, liver).
mnemonics.zh: 左心衰竭=肺(Lung);右心衰竭=全身其餘(水腫、頸靜脈、肝)。

mnemonics.en: Osler nodes are Ouch (painful); Janeway lesions are not.
Beck triad of tamponade: hypotension, JVD, muffled heart sounds.
mnemonics.zh: 心包填塞Beck三聯徵:低血壓、頸靜脈怒張、心音遙遠。

stem.en: A client with type 2 diabetes is scheduled for cardiac catheterization. Which medication should be withheld 24 hours before the procedure?
stem.zh: 第2型糖尿病個案預定接受心導管檢查。哪一種藥物應於術前24小時停用?

rationale.en: Contrast dye can impair kidney function; metformin then raises lactic acidosis risk.
rationale.zh: 顯影劑可能損害腎功能,併用metformin會增加乳酸中毒風險。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client has sinus bradycardia at 45/min, BP 82/60 and dizziness. Which intervention does the nurse anticipate?
stem.zh: 個案竇性心搏過緩45次/分,血壓82/60並頭暈。護理師預期何種處置?

rationale.en: Symptomatic bradycardia is treated with oxygen, atropine, then pacing. Digoxin slows the rate; defibrillation is for pulseless VT/VF.
rationale.zh: 有症狀的心搏過緩給氧、atropine,再起搏。Digoxin會減慢心率;去顫用於無脈搏VT/VF。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client with heart failure suddenly has extreme dyspnea, tachycardia and crackles. Which actions are priorities? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 心衰竭個案突然極度呼吸困難、心搏過速、有囉音。哪些為優先處置?(多選)

rationale.en: This is pulmonary edema: high-Fowler, oxygen, diuretic, morphine to reduce preload, Foley to measure output.
rationale.zh: 此為肺水腫:高坐臥、給氧、利尿劑、morphine降前負荷、導尿監測輸出。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: The monitor shows no P waves, wide QRS complexes, and a regular ventricular rate of 160/min in an unresponsive client with no pulse. What is the first action?
stem.zh: 監視器顯示無P波、QRS變寬、心室律規則160次/分,個案無意識且無脈搏。首要處置為何?

options.en: Begin CPR and defibrillate as soon as available

rationale.en: Pulseless VT is treated like VF: CPR and immediate unsynchronized defibrillation.
rationale.zh: 無脈搏VT處理同VF:CPR與立即非同步去顫。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which energy setting is used for defibrillation with a monophasic defibrillator?
stem.zh: 單相去顫器去顫時使用哪個能量?

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Four hours after aortoiliac bypass grafting, a client's leg is warm, red and slightly edematous with a palpable pedal pulse. How does the nurse interpret this?
stem.zh: 主動脈髂動脈繞道術後4小時,個案腿部溫熱、發紅、輕微水腫,足背脈搏可摸到。護理師如何判讀?

options.en: Expected result of increased blood flow

options.zh: 移植血管阻塞;通知外科醫師

rationale.en: Warmth, redness, and edema are expected with revascularization. Occlusion would present with pain, pallor, and loss of pulse.
rationale.zh: 血運重建後溫熱、發紅、水腫為預期。阻塞則表現疼痛、蒼白、脈搏消失。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client is 1 day post abdominal aortic aneurysm resection with urine output 90, 50 then 28 mL over 3 hours, BUN 35 and creatinine 1.8. What is the priority?
stem.zh: 腹主動脈瘤切除術後1天,3小時尿量依序90、50、28 mL,BUN 35、肌酐1.8。優先處置為何?

rationale.en: Falling output with rising BUN/creatinine suggests acute kidney injury; urine under 30 mL/hr is reported urgently.
rationale.zh: 尿量下降合併BUN/肌酐上升提示急性腎損傷;尿量<30 mL/hr應緊急通報。

stem.en: Which findings support infective endocarditis? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 下列哪些發現支持感染性心內膜炎?(多選)

options.en: Pericardial friction rub with relief on leaning forward
options.zh: 前傾緩解的心包摩擦音

rationale.en: Splinter hemorrhages, Osler nodes, murmur and fever fit endocarditis. Friction rub = pericarditis; pulsatile mass = AAA.
rationale.zh: 甲下線狀出血、Osler結節、雜音與發燒符合心內膜炎。摩擦音=心包炎;搏動性腫塊=腹主動脈瘤。

stem.en: A client with peripheral arterial disease asks how to relieve rest pain in the foot at night. Which teaching is correct?
stem.zh: 周邊動脈疾病個案詢問如何緩解夜間足部休息痛。哪項衛教正確?

options.en: Elevate legs well above the heart
Let the leg hang in a dependent position

rationale.en: Dependency improves arterial flow to the foot. Heat can burn insensate skin; elevation and crossing legs reduce flow.
rationale.zh: 下垂可增加足部動脈血流。熱敷可能燙傷感覺遲鈍的皮膚;抬高與翹腳會減少血流。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client has BP 188/124 with severe headache, blurred vision and confusion. Which actions apply? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 個案血壓188/124,伴嚴重頭痛、視力模糊與意識混亂。哪些處置適用?(多選)

options.en: Elevate head of bed to 45 degrees
Encourage fluids by mouth ad lib

rationale.en: Hypertensive crisis needs IV drugs, frequent BP, neuro checks, I&O; fluid overload is a risk.
rationale.zh: 高血壓危象需IV藥物、頻繁量血壓、神經評估、輸出入記錄;注意水分過多的風險。
